title: PackageNavigationReceipt
description: Immutable result of one edition-specific navigation request.

id.description: Immutable identity allocated once by the interoperability owner.

registration_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

from_occurrence_id.description: Current activity at input, when applicable.
from_occurrence_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

target_occurrence_id.description: Validated target for choice or jump when present.
target_occurrence_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

delivery_occurrence_id.description: New leaf selected by edition sequencing engine.
delivery_occurrence_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

request_source.description: Which authenticated command source initiated navigation.

prior_sequence_revision.description: State revision compared before process execution.

delivery_attempt_id.x-reference-scope: Reference must resolve inside the owning Institution or the directly owned aggregate.

transition_trace.description: Bounded ordered normative process trace with protected values excluded.

reason_code.description: Edition result or rejected prerequisite reason.

sequence_revision.description: Monotonic aggregate revision used for compare-and-swap.

x-invariants: Each successful request serializes against authoritative sequencing revision.
Replay never starts a duplicate activity attempt.
